claim: Foot Locker France APC (Accord de Performance Collective) reported by an anonymous employee-awareness Instagram account (@awareness.see), 31 Jul-5 Aug 2026. Reported terms: a mandatory national mobility clause (3 months' notice; enhanced indemnity only beyond 60 km or 2 hours), individual commission replaced by a collective bonus, annualised hours including part-timers, weekly overtime premium removed, and a 13th month only after 15 years' service. Employees would have 1 month to refuse in writing; silence counts as acceptance.
data_point: Draft APC terms per 3 verified posts (DbedYihsB11 31 Jul; DbeeX3-MhAb 31 Jul; DbqYreqs-JO 5 Aug, tagged #APC #AccordDePerformance). No union, press, CSE minutes or Legifrance deposit corroborates it.
original_quote: C'est imminent. Foot Locker s'apprete a vous signer un accord qui va tout changer... Mobilite nationale obligatoire. Fin du commissionnement. Annualisation du temps de travail... Le silence vaut acceptation. Vous aurez 1 mois pour refuser par ecrit.
english_translation: It's imminent. Foot Locker is about to sign an agreement that will change everything... Mandatory national mobility. End of commission. Annualised working time... Silence counts as acceptance. You will have 1 month to refuse in writing.
verifier_note: Opened the posts in a browser (no login). Account awareness.see; text matches the scraper's quotes; dates 31 Jul and 5 Aug. The mobility post says refusing a transfer is a disciplinary fault, or a dismissal after accepting the accord. The 1-month refusal window and silence-as-acceptance fit the APC mechanism (Code du travail L2254-2). The only comment calls the post nonsense. Anonymous, uncorroborated, small account, no union named: tier C. Not in the brief, baseline or other confirmed files.

claim: The live French FL locator still counts closed stores. Of its 142 entries, at least 3 are closed: Marseille Centre Bourse (05397) is listed with normal Mon-Sat hours although La Provence reported it closed on 2026-01-07, and Avignon Marchands (05107) and Lyon Confluence (05305) are still listed but show 'Fermee' every day. That leaves 139 or fewer French stores trading. In Italy, Taranto CC Mongolfiera (06342) is still listed with hours although Google Maps flags it permanently closed.
data_point: FR badge total 142 live, of which at least 3 are closed, so 139 or fewer trading. IT: Taranto 06342 (same phone 099 9933086 as the closed Maps pin) is a zombie listing. Reggio Emilia 06128 is not a zombie: the store moved to the I Petali mall on 2025-02-02 (Gazzetta di Reggio) and the listing keeps the old address.
source_name: stores.footlocker.fr / stores.footlocker.it live pages; La Provence 2026-01-07; Google Maps
original_quote: FOOT LOCKER FRANCE 5397 CENTRE BOURSE 17 COURS BELSUNCE Marseille ... Lundi 10 h 00 - 18 h 00
english_translation: Locator entry for Centre Bourse still shows Monday 10:00-18:00 opening hours.
verifier_note: Fetched all 5 locator pages on 2026-10-07. Marseille and Taranto show trading hours; Avignon and Lyon show every day closed, so the locator half-flags them but still counts them. The Taranto Maps pin is permanently closed. REFUTED in part: Reggio Emilia is a relocation, so Italy has 1 confirmed zombie, not 2 or more. The scraper's '10 or more French closures (-6.7%) since the deal' depends on the deal-day count of 149 having no stale entries. B_w1_registry-france-bodacc puts robust post-close closures at about 5 and already notes stale entries (Avignon). Downgraded A to C; only the specific Marseille, Lyon and Taranto zombie entries are new.

claim: Wayback history of FL locator badge totals: France had 149 stores on deal-close day (2025-09-08) and 142 live (2026-10-07), -7 or -4.7% in 13 months. Italy had 159 (2025-10-10), 157 (2026-03) and 154 live, -3.1%. The earlier snapshots are FR 149/148/150 and IT 159/160/158/159 (2024-01 to 2025-06).
data_point: FR 149 (2025-09-08) -> 142 (2026-10-07); IT 159 (2025-10-10) -> 154. Annualised, about -4.3% for France and -3% for Italy: in line with, not above, the ~4%/yr Europe run-rate.
source_name: stores.footlocker.fr/fr/ and stores.footlocker.it/it/ directory badges, live and Wayback (computed)
verifier_note: Re-summed the location-count badges myself: Wayback FR 2025-09-08 = 149, Wayback IT 2025-10-10 = 159, live FR = 142, live IT = 154. The other snapshots are not re-verified. The live counts duplicate the C_w1_labor-rest census; the new part is the deal-date time series. Downgraded A to B: locator totals include stale listings, so they lag reality, and the trend is not above consensus.

claim: Foot Locker Italy Srl (Milan, CF 10322270157) 2025 accounts per the reportaziende.it registry aggregator: revenue EUR 354.3M (-10.1%) vs EUR 394.1M in 2024 and EUR 369.4M in 2023; net profit EUR 4.2M (-52%) vs EUR 8.9M in both 2024 and 2023; net margin 1.2%. retail&food (2025-09-10) gave 2024 revenue as EUR 391.1M (+6.7%), EBIT EUR 11.25M (-5%), net EUR 8.8M, about 160 directly operated stores and EUR 9.4M of investment.
data_point: Italy 2025 revenue -10.1% to EUR 354.3M; net profit halved to EUR 4.2M but still positive.
original_quote: Nel 2024, il fatturato era EUR 394,1 milioni ... EUR 354,3 milioni nel 2025 (in moderato calo, -10.1%). L'utile netto e passato da EUR 8,9 milioni nel 2024 a EUR 4,2 milioni nel 2025
english_translation: Revenue was EUR 394.1M in 2024 and EUR 354.3M in 2025 (-10.1%). Net profit went from EUR 8.9M in 2024 to EUR 4.2M in 2025.
verifier_note: Fetched both pages: the aggregator figures (including 2023 revenue 369.4M) and the retail&food figures are as stated. Caveats: the 2025 numbers come from one aggregator and I did not check them against the filed bilancio. The fiscal period is not shown (FL years end around 31 Jan, so '2025' may be the year to Jan-2026, which includes about 5 post-deal months; this is inference). The 391.1M vs 394.1M gap for 2024 is probably revenue vs value of production. Not in the baseline or other confirmed files.

claim: Lyon Confluence mall: the Foot Locker unit has closed, and the landlord has re-let it to Adidas. This is a permanent closure, not the refit that the 'temporarily closed' locator flag suggests.
data_point: 1 named closure in Lyon (2nd arr.), by 2026-04-22; the unit is re-let to an Adidas own store. The locator entry 05305 (112 cours Charlemagne) still exists with all days shown as closed.
original_quote: Elle s'installera dans le local anciennement occupe par Foot Locker, qui a ferme ses portes.
english_translation: It (Adidas) will move into the unit formerly occupied by Foot Locker, which has closed.
verifier_note: Article fetched; datePublished 2026-04-22 and the quote is verbatim. The exact closure date is not given, so it could predate the deal (inference: probably not, since it was counted in the 2025-09-08 locator snapshot). D_w1_chatter lists Lyon Confluence as possibly a refit ('temporarily closed' on the locator); this source shows a permanent exit with the unit re-let. Not otherwise in the confirmed files.

claim: Italian FL stores flagged permanently closed on Google Maps, mostly before the deal: Taranto CC Mongolfiera (still on the locator), Rimini Le Befane (closed by Sep-2024), Torino 8 Gallery, Beinasco Le Fornaci, Bari Mongolfiera Santa Caterina, Andria and La Spezia.
data_point: Few identifiable post-deal Italian closures. The Italian locator carries at least 1 stale entry (Taranto).
verifier_note: Verified only Taranto: the Maps pin 'C.C. La Mongolfiera, Via per Montemesola' is permanently closed, with 267 reviews and the same phone as locator entry 06342. The review dates and the other 6 pins were not re-checked (limited Maps view). Mostly pre-deal, so low value. Italy is not covered by D_w1_chatter.

claim: Two Italian city-centre FL closures in Jan-Feb 2025, before the deal. Bologna via d'Azeglio closed; FL stays in the city at via Indipendenza. Reggio Emilia via Emilia Santo Stefano closed and moved to the I Petali mall from 2025-02-02.
data_point: 1 net closure (Bologna) and 1 relocation (Reggio Emilia), both pre-deal.
source_name: la Repubblica Bologna (Sabrina Camonchia); Gazzetta di Reggio
original_quote: Via d'Azeglio, chiude Foot Locker e arriva Legami ... La catena di abbigliamento sportivo resta in citta con il negozio in via Indipendenza
english_translation: Via d'Azeglio: Foot Locker closes and Legami arrives ... The sportswear chain stays in the city with its via Indipendenza store.
verifier_note: Repubblica (2025-02-01) headline and standfirst verified. Gazzetta di Reggio (2025-01-27) says the store 'annuncia in vetrina il trasferimento al centro commerciale I petali a partire da domenica 2 febbraio', so it is a relocation, not an exit. Downgraded B to C: pre-deal, and one of the two is a relocation.

claim: AGAINST (weak): the shopfitter L2A Agencement says it refitted 16 Foot Locker France stores from July 2024 'in one year' under FL's national modernisation programme, including Rennes/Saint-Gregoire Grand Quartier (150 m2, 5 days, 2025).
data_point: 16 French stores (about 11% of the fleet) refitted from Jul-2024 to about mid-2025, mostly before the deal.
original_quote: Depuis juillet 2024, 16 boutiques Foot Locker ont deja ete transformees par les equipes L2A a travers la France. Foot Locker poursuit son programme de modernisation de ses points de vente
english_translation: Since July 2024, 16 Foot Locker stores across France have been transformed by L2A. Foot Locker is continuing its store modernisation programme.
verifier_note: Page fetched; published 2025-08-06; quote verbatim, and it also says '16 boutiques Foot Locker transformees en un an'. Downgraded B to C: the refit wave was decided and largely done before DKS ownership, which is the same treatment B_w1_registry-france-bodacc gave its pre-deal investment evidence. Not in other confirmed files.
